question: There is only one runway which will be used by seven flights one by one. P and Q will use the runway neither first nor last. S will use it second after R. M will use it second before O. N will use it after O and before R. Q will use it just before S. Who will use the runway in the middle?
solution:
1) M will use it second before O.

2) S will use it second after R.

3) N will use it after O and before R.
